idea-plugin.name: AutoSpring
idea-plugin.description:
AutoSpring is an intelligent backend code automation plugin for IntelliJ IDEA that generates complete, production-ready Spring Boot application layers directly from your JPA entities — in a single click, with zero boilerplate writing.

⚡ One-Click Full-Stack Backend Generation: Automatically creates Controllers, Services, Repositories, DTOs, Mappers, Entities and Exception Handling — with multi-entity support and relationship-aware code.

🧾 Local Prompt Mode: Describe an entity and the backend layers you need in plain structured text. AutoSpring parses it deterministically inside the IDE, shows an editable plan and file preview, and reuses the same generators — no AI service, account or API key required.

🔐 Auto-Configured Security & Auth: Generates JWT authentication filters, security configuration, user details services, auth controllers and DTOs — ready to protect your APIs out of the box.

🛢️ Database Automation: Choose MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB or H2 and AutoSpring injects the correct drivers and configuration automatically.

🧠 Smart Dependency Management: Detects and adds required dependencies (JPA, Validation, Swagger, Security, Database drivers) to your build file so your generated code compiles immediately.

📄 Built-In Production Features: Swagger/OpenAPI docs, pagination, JPA auditing, global exception handlers, error responses and generated README documentation — all wired up for you.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Version 1.2.0

  • ✨ Feature: Added a local, deterministic prompt-to-code workflow with an editable generation plan, file preview and structured task report
  • 🛢️ Feature: Added optional database selection (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, H2) to the entity workflow
  • ⚡ Enhancement: Automatic database driver injection based on selection
  • 🧠 Improvement: Smart dependency injection (JPA, Swagger, Security, DB drivers)
  • 🚀 Upgrade: Migrated to IntelliJ Platform Gradle Plugin 2.x
  • 🚀 Compatibility: Updated for IntelliJ IDEA 2024.3+
  • 🔧 Fix: Improved build compatibility and removed upper build restriction
